messages:
anya: Quick coordination: we plan a staged publish of py/ts SDK tonight in the 01:00-03:00 UTC quiet window. This is a staggered promotion: cohort A -> cohort B -> optional GA. No automatic dist-tag flip until manual approve.

radek: +1. Who's handling pinback if we see issues? Also need exact abort metrics.

jun: I'll run the smoke harness and watch telemetry. Abort if: install errors >4%, import failures >1%, or new uncaught exceptions in production harness. If abort -> run 'yank-cohort' and mark artifacts in index.

release-bot: deploybot: publish-started packages=[redwood-sdk-py, redwood-sdk-ts], mode=staged, initiator=anya

anya: Publish steps: build -> upload to internal index with metadata `cohort=A-staged` -> smoke -> promote to cohort B after 2h if healthy. Commands in release doc.

radek: Added note: when promoting to GA we must add deprecation notice for old major in CHANGELOG and set migration guide link.

jun: +05m smoke: py install success 99.7%, ts install success 99.9%, basic import/generate OK. No runtime errors seen.

release-bot: deploybot: publish-complete cohort=A-staged artifacts=uploaded

anya: Thanks. We'll observe 2 hours and reconvene here before cohort B flip. If anyone needs to abort, ping "ABORT STAGED" and @radek will execute tag yank.
